blocks.text: Hearthpod carries the quiet warmth of a used room in a small lidded form. Its opening is a domestic gesture, a reminder that ordinary care remains valuable even when older worlds and institutions have contracted.
A rounded teal miniature kiln shell with uneven ivory roof plates and a peach spiral vent.
One-shot use: The lid lifts completely off and rests beside the hearth while peach beads rise, circulate, and settle back into the open pot. The game performs the final fade.

26 silver. Exhaustion / Injury severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Energy +8; Health +8. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
